title: Loudoun County 3-Winery Tour from DC Metro or Leesburg
includes: Visits to three Loudoun County wineries
Discounts & Extras Exclusive to Vineyard Voyages Guests
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Only for adults 21 years or older.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Leave the route planning and driving to us on a relaxed day in Loudoun County wine country. Vineyard Voyages visits three wineries on one of our rotating scheduled routes, with convenient meeting points at West Falls Church Metro or Market Station in Leesburg.

A Certified Tourism Ambassador guide hosts the experience while a professional driver handles the road, so you can focus on the scenery, wine, and time together. Each stop brings a different setting and personality, and the day is thoughtfully paced so you have time to taste, explore, and purchase lunch without organizing multiple cars or choosing a designated driver.

Choose Explorer for transportation, your guide, and three winery visits while purchasing tastings as you go. Choose Connoisseur for the same hosted experience plus one pre-selected tasting or flight at each of the three wineries. Lunch and additional purchases are separate with both ticket types.
